text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We're done shopping, so
let's hurry back and prepare for training—

text_block_list.name: Construction Site Guard
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, please make a detour~.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It ended up being a bit of a detour,
but once I turn this corner, the academy is right...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, no matter when I come here,
it's so straight and refreshing just to look at."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O simply ran straight along the road.
She felt completely refreshed, but had entirely forgotten about the training.
